label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, early/mid episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass; never at D1 or D2) and 91% of its activation mass falls on GO steps whose previous trial went unrewarded (rate 10% vs 2% after reward). It also fades over the episode: the rate is about 30% on trials 1-9, falls to 5% by trial 40, and is nearly zero after trial 70, so it looks like a slow drift in hidden state as well as an outcome signal. The predicate GO & prev_reward==0 & ep_trial<60 keeps 89% of mass on dev with precision 0.49 (F1 0.58), and the top activation quartile is covered completely. Many GO-after-no-reward steps stay silent, and adding the transition type, the value-head output (high-value GO steps are enriched) or policy confidence did not help much. The lowest-quartile activations are scattered, including after rewarded trials. Magnitude is largest after no reward early in the episode. It does not fire on rewarded-input steps at D1, or at any D1/D2 step. All variables used are observed.
